SGWU BOARD OF GOVERNORS 
ANNOUNCE 
TWO NEW APPOINTMENTS 


FROM THE INFORMATION OFFICE 
Vi. -013) Local 130 
GERALD WRIGHT DIRECTOR 


SIR GEORGE WILLIAMS 
UNIVERSITY AND SCHOOLS 


METROPOLITAN YMCA 
OF MONTREAL 


May Ith, 1963 


TWO NEW APPOINTMENTS TO THE BOARD OF GOVERNORS OF 
SIR GEORGE WILLIAMS UNIVERSITY WERE MADE KNOWN TO- 
DAY BY THE CHANCELLOR, B. W. ROBERTS. THEY ARE 

MR. FRED N. DUNDAS, B. COM., F.C.1.S., PRESIDENT 

OF DOMINION GLASS CO. LTD., MONTREAL, AND MR. E. 
PAUL ZIMMERMAN, PRESIDENT OF READER'S DIGEST ASSOCIA- 
TION, CANADA, LTD. IN ADDITION TO THESE TWO NEW 
APPOINTMENTS, MR. J. G. BRADLEY, B.A., B.COM., HAS 
BEEN ELECTED A GOVERNOR AS REPRESENTATIVE OF THE 
SGWU ALUMNI ASSOCIATION AND MR. GORDON C. DONALDSON, 
B.A., WHO HAS REPRESENTED THE ALUMNI FOR A NUMBER 

OF YEARS NOW BECOMES A FULL MEMBER OF THE BOARD OF 


GOVERNORS.
